doc.title: Microsoft Teams

application.doc: Microsoft Teams enables you to get all your content, tools and conversations in the team workspace with Microsoft 365.

Send a Microsoft Graph HTTP request Construct a Microsoft Graph REST API request to invoke against the Microsoft Teams endpoints. These segments are supported: 1st segment: /teams, /me, /users 2nd segment: channels, chats, installedApps, messages, pinnedMessages, onlineMeetings. Learn more: https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/graph/use-the-api
The full or relative URI. Example: https://graph.microsoft.com/{version}/{resource}

Add an item to a section Adds an item (chat, channel, meeting, or community) currently in a system-defined section to a user-defined teamwork section. Use Move Section Item to relocate items already in another user-defined section.

The value of the @microsoft.graph.sectionsVersion annotation returned when you list sections, or the @odata.etag value from any previously retrieved section. Required for optimistic concurrency control.
The section ID
The section item ID (the conversation ID of the underlying chat, channel, meeting, or community)

Remove an item from a section Removes an item from a user-defined teamwork section. The underlying chat, channel, meeting, or community is not deleted; the item returns to its default system-defined section.

The value of the @microsoft.graph.sectionsVersion annotation returned when you list sections, or the @odata.etag value from any previously retrieved section. Required for optimistic concurrency control.
The section ID
The section item ID (the conversation ID of the underlying chat, channel, meeting, or community)

Move a section item Atomically moves an item from one user-defined teamwork section to another user-defined section. Each item can belong to only one section at a time. This action removes the item from its current section and adds it to the target section.

The value of the @microsoft.graph.sectionsVersion annotation returned when you list sections, or the @odata.etag value from any previously retrieved section. Required for optimistic concurrency control.
